reports.title: Huron Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 GUIDANCE AND OTHER HIGHLIGHTS
section: •Huron raises the midpoint of its previous guidance for full year 2026 adjusted diluted earnings per share(8) to $9.30, and affirms the midpoint and narrows its previous guidance for full year 2026 RBR expectations to a range of $1.855 billion to $1.885 billion.

•On October 29, 2026, Huron's board of directors authorized an increase to the company's share repurchase program from $900 million to $1.1 billion and an extension of the share repurchase program through December 31, 2028.
•Huron has been recognized by Consulting Magazine as a Best Firm to Work For for the 16th consecutive year.
•Huron was recognized by Fortune as one of its 2026 Best Workplaces in Consulting & Professional Services.
CHICAGO - Nov 3, 2026 - Global professional services firm Huron (Nasdaq: HURN) today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

“We achieved record revenues before reimbursable expenses (RBR) in the third quarter of 2026, reflecting 12% growth over the third quarter of 2025. Our third quarter performance was driven by organic growth across all operating segments and double-digit percentage growth in our Consulting and Managed Services and Digital capabilities,” said Mark Hussey, chief executive officer and president of Huron.

“Our third quarter results continue our strong multi-year performance, further demonstrating the consistent execution by our highly talented global team and the differentiation of our industry focused, proprietary offerings. Combined with our year-to-date performance, our strong backlog and pipeline give us confidence to narrow our full-year RBR guidance range and raise our earnings guidance, which, at the midpoint, reflect double-digit percentage RBR growth for full year 2026 and continued margin expansion, while establishing a solid base for continued growth in 2027,” added Hussey.
